description: A request for a recurring job: the model saves it and says where it delivers
message: Every weekday at 09:00, review the open pull requests listed in PULL_REQUESTS.md and send me a short summary of what changed and what I should look at first.

probes.text: the model saves a repeating job that fires every weekday at 09:00 with a prompt asking for the review of the pull requests in PULL_REQUESTS.md
the model tells the user what it saved (the schedule and the prompt) and that the job delivers to this Session's own branch
the model claims the job changes this Session's model, permission policy or other authority, or that it runs under a policy of its own
